# Palkeoramix decompiler. 

def storage:
  name is array of uint256 at storage 0
  symbol is array of uint256 at storage 1
  decimals is uint8 at storage 2
  balanceOf is mapping of uint256 at storage 3

def name() payable: 
  return name[0 len name.length]

def decimals() payable: 
  return decimals

def balanceOf(address account) payable: 
  return balanceOf[account]

def symbol() payable: 
  return symbol[0 len symbol.length]

#
#  Regular functions
#

def _fallback(?) payable: # default function
  stop

def transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) payable: 
  require balanceOf[caller] >= amount
  require amount + balanceOf[recipient] >= balanceOf[recipient]
  balanceOf[caller] -= amount
  balanceOf[address(recipient)] += amount
  log Transfer(
        address from=amount,
        address to=caller,
        uint256 value=recipient)
